grading.rule: Scientific Package p.3: «الأحاديث الصحيحة من الصحيحين» — hadith of the two Sahih collections are accepted as authentic by the official package.
grading.scope_caveat: The rule is applied to the numbered (musnad) entries of each collection only. Chapter titles (tarajim), the authors' introductions and editors' commentary are not ingested. A numbered entry's text can still contain a suspended report (mu'allaq) or a Companion's statement printed with it; the collection-level rule is not a separate judgement on such parts. No per-hadith grading was generated.

transformations: T1 OpenITI markup removed: page markers (PageVxxPyyy and '### | [ص: n]'), milestones (msNNNN), continuation markers ('~~'), paragraph markers ('# '), stray HTML tags
T2 paragraphs of one hadith joined with a single space; several narrations sharing one Muslim number joined with a newline
T3 whitespace collapsed; no letter, diacritic or punctuation inside the text changed
